observations: Four photos show tables with metal frames and wooden tops, designed to resemble sewing machines.
The tables have a rectangular metal frame with four legs, a central metal treadle mechanism, and a metal footrest or shelf below.
The tops are made of wood with a visible grain pattern; one has a blue painted surface, another a brown wood finish, and the third a grey patterned surface.
The treadle mechanism includes a handwheel and a metal plate with measurement markings (photo 2).
The footrest has a grid design and appears to be made of metal.
The tables are placed outdoors on a cracked concrete surface, with dirt and debris around.
No brand or model markings are visible on any of the tables.
The seller claims they are 'Sewing and Weaving machine legs' and priced at 48k.

claims.evidence: The photos show tables with metal frames, treadle mechanisms, and footrests consistent with sewing machine legs.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The treadle mechanism may be non-functional or damaged.
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo showing the treadle being operated and the handwheel turning smoothly.

risks.risk: The metal frame may be rusted or structurally weak.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the metal frame, especially joints and legs, showing condition and any rust.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or corroded

risks.risk: The wooden tops may be damaged or warped.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the wooden tops showing any cracks, warping, or unevenness.

proof_requests: A close-up video or photo of the treadle mechanism being operated.
A close-up photo of the metal frame, especially joints and legs, to check for rust or damage.
A close-up photo of the wooden tops to check for cracks or warping.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
